title: Operations & Compliance Manager
description:
**About the role**

We are hiring an Operations &Compliance Manager who owns every client's work from the moment they are onboarded until the final deliverable is handed over.

TaxCrafted Solutions is a pan-India compliance services company based in Delhi. We help businesses with company incorporation, GST registration, FSSAI licensing, trademark registration, ISO certification and ongoing company compliance. Our sister brand, MediaNuts, offers digital marketing services.

**Position: Operations & Compliance Manager**

**Experience: 3-5 Years**

**Type: Full-time**

**Key responsibilities**

**Contact No: 8796405906**

You will run each client's work end to end, in this order:

1. Client onboarding — Receive the closed client from the sales team. Review the service purchased, payment status and documents shared.

2. Understand the requirement — Speak with the client within 24 hours of onboarding. Confirm scope, timelines and the documents still needed.

3. Document collection — Prepare a clear checklist for the client and follow up until all documents are complete and verified.

4. Assign work to the team — Allocate the task to the right person (incorporation, GST, FSSAI, trademark, ISO, compliance) with a clear deadline.

5. Track progress daily — Maintain a work tracker for every open file. Remove blockers, escalate delays and re-plan where needed.

6. Client communication — Keep the client updated at each stage on WhatsApp and calls. Handle queries and concerns promptly.

7. Quality check — Review the final work (applications, certificates, filings) for accuracy before it reaches the client.

8. Final delivery & closure — Hand over the completed work, collect any pending payment, take feedback and close the file.

Alongside this, you will:

* Share a daily/weekly status report with the founders
* Coordinate with sales so the right information passes at handover
* Identify upsell opportunities (compliance, trademark, MediaNuts services) and pass them to sales
* Improve processes, checklists and SOPs to reduce turnaround time

Who we are looking for

Must have

* Graduate (B.Com / BBA / MBA preferred)
* 2–4 years in operations or client servicing, ideally at a CA firm, legal-tech or compliance services company
* Working knowledge of incorporation, GST, FSSAI, trademark or ROC compliance processes
* Strong communication in Hindi and English, on calls and WhatsApp
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets and work trackers

Good to have

* Experience managing a small team of executives
* Familiarity with MCA, GST and FSSAI portals

Qualities

* Ownership: treats every file as their own until it is closed
* Organised, follows up without being reminded
* Calm with clients, firm with deadlines

Compensation & how to apply

* Salary: 25000 - 40,000 per month (based on experience)
* Working days: Monday to Saturday
* Location: 807, DDA 2, BUILDING, DISTRICT CENTRE, JANAKPURI WEST, NEW DELHI

To apply, send your CV to hr@taxcraftedsolutions.com or WhatsApp 8796405906

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

title: Property Lawyer
description:
About Us

Greyy Elephant Ideaz Private Limited is a real\-estate company. We are looking for a property lawyer to join our in\-house team and take ownership of the legal side of our property transactions, from due diligence to documentation.

Role Overview

You will be the company's go\-to legal expert on property matters. You will verify titles, draft and vet agreements, manage legal risk on land and property acquisitions, and work with our business, finance, and project teams so deals close cleanly and on time.

Key Responsibilities

**Title Due Diligence and Chain of Title**

* Examine title documents and trace the complete chain of title for land and properties under consideration
* Review sale deeds, conveyance deeds, gift and partition deeds, wills, and power of attorney documents
* Verify revenue records (jamabandi, mutation entries, khasra/khatauni, etc.), encumbrance certificates, and municipal and development authority records
* Identify defects, encumbrances, litigation, and boundary or possession issues, and recommend how to resolve them
* Prepare clear legal title reports and risk summaries for management

**Drafting and Documentation**

* Draft, review, and negotiate agreements to sell, sale deeds, lease and license agreements, joint development and collaboration agreements, development agreements, and MOUs
* Prepare allotment letters, buyer agreements, and other customer\-facing documents in line with applicable law
* Draft legal notices, replies, affidavits, indemnities, and undertakings
* Maintain standard templates and clause libraries to speed up recurring transactions

**Transaction and Compliance Support**

* Support land acquisition and property purchase and sale from due diligence through registration
* Coordinate stamp duty payment, registration, and mutation work with sub\-registrar offices and authorities
* Ensure compliance with RERA and other applicable real\-estate, land\-use, and local regulations
* Assist with approvals, licenses, and NOCs required for projects

**Litigation and Dispute Management**

* Monitor property\-related disputes and coordinate with external counsel on litigation, arbitration, and recovery matters
* Brief external advocates, track case status, and report to management
* Advise on pre\-litigation strategy and settlements

**Advisory and Internal Coordination**

* Give day\-to\-day legal advice to management and business teams
* Flag legal risks early and suggest practical solutions
* Maintain organized, secure records of all title documents and legal files

Requirements

**Must have**

* LL.B. (LL.M. preferred) from a recognized university, enrolled with a State Bar Council
* Proven experience in property law, ideally as an in\-house counsel or with a real\-estate developer or firm
* Strong hands\-on experience in **title search and title chain verification**
* Strong **drafting** skills for property agreements and deeds
* Solid knowledge of the Transfer of Property Act, Registration Act, Indian Stamp Act, RERA, and relevant state land laws
* Ability to read and interpret revenue and land records

**Good to have**

* Experience with land acquisition, joint ventures, or large\-scale development projects
* Exposure to property litigation and RERA proceedings
* Working knowledge of Hindi and English, written and spoken

Skills and Attributes

* Meticulous attention to detail and sound legal judgment
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication
* Ability to explain legal issues to non\-legal colleagues
* Good negotiation skills
* Ownership, integrity, and the ability to handle multiple matters at once

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
